description_short.value: Holding company of Marshalls University College, a small private tertiary college in Accra, and a pre-university school; traded on the Ghana Alternative Market and loss-making every year since 2022.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Meridian Marshalls Holdings Limited consolidated reports and financial statements for the year ended 31 July 2023 (GSE PR 432/2023: nature of business, notes 1 and 14a, statement of consolidated comprehensive income)

description_full.value: Meridian Marshalls Holdings Limited owns all of Marshalls University College Limited, a private tertiary college in Accra, and Meridian Pre-University, and is registered to carry on education and research and to import and export educational materials. Its main campus is at Odorkor, on the Kasoa-Mallam highway, and its registered office is in the NTHC Estate at East Airport, Accra. The company raised capital through an initial public offer in 2015 and its shares were listed on the Ghana Alternative Market on 7 July 2015. Dr Tetteh Nettey and Mrs Genevieve Naa Aku Nettey each hold 39.03% of the 96.1 million shares, and CAL Brokers 17.33%. It is a very small business: tuition and other fees were about GHS 1.0 million in each of the years to July 2022 and July 2023 and GHS 1.2 million in the year to July 2024, and it has made a loss after tax every year since 2022. Its equity fell from GHS 1.7 million in July 2021 to GHS 0.8 million in July 2024. Its liabilities are mostly amounts owed to its directors and other payables, and the 2023 auditors noted a working-capital shortfall of about GHS 5.2 million, a current ratio of 0.25, and that its going concern was "highly in doubt". No dividend has been recommended in any recent year.
